topic: Rushing to pay a medical collection vs disputing under new reporting rules (Rex vs Nell)

scenes.narration: A medical bill he rushed to pay never belonged on his credit. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside a giant medical bill and a credit report marked with a red X, comic burst banner reads WRONGLY REPORTED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rex and Nell each find a medical collection on their reports.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man rex and woman nell in the courtroom, each finding a medical collection on their credit reports, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: New rules keep small and paid medical debts off reports.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a glowing rule book on the courtroom bench labeled SMALL AND PAID MEDICAL DEBTS OFF REPORTS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rex panics and pays the collector the full amount immediately.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man rex hastily paying a collector the full amount, a receipt stamped PAID IN FULL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He never checks whether the bill was even accurate first.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man rex signing a payment without reading, a bill behind him marked UNCHECKED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nell requests an itemized bill and disputes the collection instead.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman nell requesting papers, a document labeled ITEMIZED BILL and a form stamped DISPUTE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She finds billing errors and a balance below the reporting threshold.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman nell circling billing errors, a balance labeled BELOW REPORTING THRESHOLD highlighted, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The bureaus must remove the small, disputed medical debt entirely.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a credit report with the medical debt entry being erased, a stamp reads REMOVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Later, Rex realizes he paid a bill that shouldn't report.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man rex realizing his mistake, holding a paid receipt beside a report that stayed unchanged, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He overpaid errors and got no credit boost in return.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man rex looking at a flat credit score meter, a note reads NO BOOST after overpaying, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nell's report is clean and she paid nothing at all.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman nell smiling at a clean credit report stamped CLEAR, a note reads PAID NOTHING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Verify and dispute medical debts before paying; small ones shouldn't report. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads VERIFY AND DISPUTE BEFORE PAYING, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
